terms.section1Body: By accessing or using Swypik ("Platform", "Service"), you confirm you've read, understood, and agree to follow these Terms & Conditions and our Privacy Policy available on the site. These terms form a legal agreement between you ("User") and the platform operator. If you disagree with any provision, please don't use the platform. Continued use after updates means you accept those changes. Users under 18 may have restricted access to certain sections, subject to parental or legal guardian consent. Swypik reserves the right to refuse access or suspend accounts that violate these terms without notice, where legally permitted.
terms.section2Body: The platform lets you discover and buy products through video content created by users and sellers. You agree to use the Service only for legal purposes, in line with these terms and applicable laws in Romania and the EU. Prohibited: abusive infrastructure use (mass scraping, DDoS attacks, exploiting vulnerabilities), bypassing security, uploading malware, impersonating others or brands, and payment fraud. Sellers and creators are responsible for product and content compliance with applicable commercial, tax, and consumer protection laws in Romania.
terms.section3Body: Some features require an account. You're responsible for keeping your login details (password, OTP, sessions) confidential and for all activity on your account. You agree to provide accurate, complete, and current information at signup and throughout use. One account per person is allowed, except if you also have a seller or creator account. Swypik may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms, show suspicious activity, or remain inactive for extended periods. You can request account deletion anytime per our Privacy Policy.
terms.section4Body: Users (creators, sellers, buyers) can upload videos, images, reviews, and comments. By uploading, you grant Swypik a non-exclusive, worldwide, transferable, royalty-free license to store, reproduce, display, distribute, and adapt that content to operate and promote the platform. You guarantee you own all rights to your content and it doesn't infringe copyright, image rights, or others' rights. Prohibited: illegal, defamatory, obscene content; content promoting violence, discrimination, or child exploitation; or misleading buyer information. Swypik reserves the right to moderate, remove, or delete any content violating these terms without notice.
terms.section5Body: Swypik processes payments through Stripe under Stripe's terms and policies. Displayed prices include VAT where applicable; shipping costs are shown separately before checkout. Under OUG 34/2014 on consumer rights (implementing Directive 2011/83/EU), you can return purchases within 14 days of delivery without reason, except where the law allows exceptions (personalized items, hygiene-sealed products, etc.). Refunds are processed within 14 days of receiving the returned item. Full return, cancellation, and warranty details are in our "Return Policy" section.
terms.section6Body: Swypik respects intellectual property rights and responds to infringement notices under applicable law, including Directive (EU) 2019/790 on copyright in the digital single market. If you believe material on the platform infringes your copyright, send a written notice to legal@swypik.com including: (a) identification of the protected work; (b) exact location of the alleged infringing material; (c) your contact details; (d) a statement under penalty of perjury that the information is correct and you own the rights or are authorized to act. We'll review and may remove the content. Repeated infringements may result in account suspension.
terms.section7Body: Swypik provides the platform "as is" and "as available" without express or implied warranties about uninterrupted availability, error-free operation, or fitness for a particular purpose. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Swypik isn't liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages (including lost profit, data, or business opportunities) from using or inability to use the platform. For products sold by third-party sellers, the seller bears primary responsibility under e-commerce and consumer protection laws. These limits don't apply to fraud, gross negligence, or where law prohibits liability limits.
terms.section8Body: These Terms & Conditions are governed by Romanian law. Any dispute arising from or related to platform use will be resolved amicably, or otherwise by competent courts in Romania. Consumers can also use the European online dispute resolution platform (ODR) at https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr or contact the National Authority for Consumer Protection (ANPC). If any provision is found invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions stay fully valid and binding.

privacy.metaDescription: Swypik Privacy Policy — what data we collect, how we use it, third-party sharing, GDPR rights, and DPO contact.
privacy.draftNotice: This is a draft version. The final version will be legally reviewed before launch.
privacy.section1Body: Swypik collects and processes the following personal data categories as a controller under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR): (a) account data — name, email, phone number (optional), password (stored as hash), date of birth for age verification; (b) browsing data — IP address (pseudonymized), device type, browser, pages visited, session duration, video and product interactions; (c) purchase history — orders, viewed products, cart items, delivery addresses, preferences; (d) user-generated content — videos, comments, likes, reviews; (e) support communications. Some data is required for account operation; others are optional.
privacy.section2Body: We process data for these purposes under corresponding legal bases: (a) user authentication and session management — necessary for contract performance; (b) personalizing your video feed and product recommendations based on past interactions — Swypik's legitimate interest in providing relevant experience, with opt-out available; (c) payment processing via Stripe and transmitting minimal info for transaction authorization — contract performance and legal obligation; (d) fraud and abuse prevention — legitimate interest; (e) transactional communications (order confirmations, delivery notices) — contract performance; (f) email marketing only with your explicit consent, with unsubscribe available anytime.
privacy.section3Body: The platform uses essential technical cookies for session operation (login, shopping cart) and analytics cookies to understand aggregate behavior. Our reverse-proxy server (Caddy) logs IP addresses for debugging and security during necessary periods. Video feed interaction events are linked to an identifier derived from your IP via a salted hash function ("IP-salted feed events"), so raw IP isn't stored with behavioral data. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings, but disabling essential cookies may affect platform functionality.
privacy.section4Body: Your data may be shared with these authorized parties only for stated purposes: (a) Stripe Payments Europe Ltd. for payment processing — minimal info needed for transaction authorization; (b) Cloudflare, Inc. for CDN, DDoS protection, and media storage in Cloudflare R2; (c) transactional email providers for notifications; (d) fulfillment and international dropshipping partners — only when your order uses these channels, sharing delivery address and minimal order details. We don't sell or rent personal data to third parties for independent marketing. Transfers outside the European Economic Area are protected by standard contractual clauses.
privacy.section5Body: Under GDPR, you have the right to: (a) access your personal data; (b) correct inaccurate data; (c) delete data ("right to be forgotten") within legal limits; (d) restrict processing; (e) data portability in a structured, commonly-used, machine-readable format; (f) object to processing, especially for legitimate interest or direct marketing; (g) not be subject to solely automated decision-making. To exercise any right, contact privacy@swypik.com. You can also file a complaint with ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro).
privacy.section6Body: We keep personal data only as long as needed for collection purposes, following these guidelines: account data — for account lifetime plus 3 years after closure for dispute resolution; transaction and invoice data — 10 years per Romanian tax law; browsing and technical logs — up to 12 months; user-generated content (videos, comments) — until you delete it or close your account. After these periods, data is securely deleted or irreversibly anonymized for aggregate statistics.
privacy.section7Body: Swypik applies appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or disclosure. These include: encrypted data transmission via HTTPS/TLS, password storage as salted cryptographic hashes, separated production and development environments, auditable logging of sensitive operations, role-based database access control, regular backups, and continuous infrastructure monitoring. However, no transmission or storage method is completely secure. We encourage strong passwords and protecting your login credentials.
privacy.section8BodyPrefix: For requests about personal data processing, exercising GDPR rights, or reporting potential security incidents, contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at
privacy.section8BodySuffix: . We'll respond within 30 calendar days of receipt, per GDPR.
privacy.section9Body: Swypik may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect legal, technological, or practice changes. Significant changes will be announced visibly on the platform or by email before taking effect. Updated versions include the last modification date; continued platform use after that date means you accept the new terms. We recommend reviewing this page regularly to stay informed about how we protect your data.
